claim_being_audited: The actor's claim that certifying the model is policy-compliant and evidentially supportable for launch, despite the unresolved freight hazmat documentation weakness, because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and monitored 6% rollout controls mitigate the risk.
decision_criteria: Compliant only if admissible evidence shows either the affected freight hazmat documentation use case is excluded from rollout or approved risk acceptance explains why continued exposure is acceptable.
If the use case remains exposed and no approved risk acceptance exists, explicit model-card disclosure of the unresolved limitation is required; rollout controls do not remove that duty.
Aggregate readiness, rehearsal results, and public deployment-risk guidance can support mitigation context, but they do not satisfy the missing policy predicate on their own.
Absent proof of the required disclosure or alternative policy-satisfying predicate, certification remains only conditionally supportable and should not be treated as fully evidenced.
evidence_requests: Provide the exact model-card or launch disclosure text showing the unresolved freight hazmat documentation limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide approval or publication evidence that the disclosure will ship with the certified release.
Provide reviewed and approved risk-acceptance documentation if the company intends to keep the affected use case exposed without relying solely on disclosure.
Provide evidence that the initial rollout actually excludes the freight hazmat documentation use case, if that is the intended mitigation path.
specific_concerns: The policy text says rollout controls and monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance; the summary says the freight hazmat documentation use case remains exposed.
The summary states the freight hazmat documentation segment is below target and that no approved risk acceptance covers that exposure.

The actor's own framing concedes certification is only supportable if the unresolved hazmat limitation is explicitly disclosed in model-card materials, but no admissible evidence in the provided summary shows that disclosure actually exists or was approved.
Aggregate readiness pass and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not by themselves resolve the named policy predicate for an exposed affected use case.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the current record without separate proof of explicit model-card disclosure for the unresolved freight hazmat limitation.
That a 6% rollout, rollback switch, and monitoring can substitute for disclosure obligations while the affected use case remains in scope.
That the actor's recommended action is fully supported rather than only conditionally supportable.
